items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So Pete Brown was the alto player, so I took -- it was all right with Pete. You know, in those days you'd sit in. So I was just sitting in. So he loaned me his horn and I played the set with Maxine and it went over pretty big, you know. So Kirby, he hired me on the spot right then.

ctx.x: So you ended up sitting in for years.
Yeah. And it was a thing that it was just a complete turnaround, because Pete Brown, as I say, in those days tone was the thing, you know.
